title: Alonzo Demetrius Releases Soulful R&B Single "Runnin'"
htmlContent:
Alonzo Demetrius, the rising star in the R&B scene, has released his latest single, "Runnin'," featuring production from Ivan Jackson, Gengis Don, and Daniel Abraham. The track tells the story of a tumultuous "situations," with Alonzo's raw vocals and introspective lyrics capturing the emotions of someone who has had enough of being strung along.

Inspired by Frank Ocean, "Runnin'" showcases Alonzo's versatility and technical precision, backed by the genre-fluid band The Ego. The B-side to "Tell Me," Alonzo's previous release, two tracks tell the story of a relationship's beginning and end, respectively.

With a Bachelor of Music degree in Professional Music from Berklee College of Music and a Master of Music from the highly selective Berklee Global Jazz Institute, Alonzo is a talented musician passionate about R&B, jazz, and gospel. His musical vocabulary and technical proficiency are fully displayed in "Runnin'," making it a must-listen for any R&B fan.
